text: {"label":"Schedules of Reinforcement and Performance","definition":"Basic, translational, and applied research on how reinforcement schedules (interval, ratio, concurrent, multiple, low-rate, and time-based) shape response patterns, preference, and treatment effects, including quantitative and theoretical accounts of schedule performance.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Covers schedule effects broadly, rather than reinforcement delay specifically, temporal control and schedule-induced pausing, or alternative-behavior reinforcement and resurgence in treating problem behavior."}
